notes.title: New Demo Sneak Preview
notes.notes:
Following from last year in September, the Hymble Ventures demo is almost ready for the major update.
After we removed the mechanics that appeared educational about autism, it expanded more room for creativity and love for the game. This led to re establishing the game’s USP’s.

Hymble is still autistic, yet that’s only distinguished from her personality and animations, executed in a subtle manner. Players should naturally pick up on the neurodiversity vibes that way. 

[h2]General Updates[/h2]

This fun, blending mechanic allows you to turn collected fruit into health-restoring smoothies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/18ecc0e578d22433080d58e804aa0fc28c38ea80.png[/img]

The character dialogue is now humorous and gives charm to each character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/e72a8786236f0b7c63bcf1a75433ada0f1414351.png[/img]

The inventory system is reduced to one table of items, plus you see a cute Hymble animation. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/251f74e2dd3ad8de44dc8f101ffda0bc83390fed.png[/img]

[h3]Power-Up(dates)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Zorb Ball is now called Hym-Bubble
[*] Boomerang is now called Hym-A-Ring
[*] Hand attack is called Hym-Bam
[/list]

[h2]Changes to Hymble’s Bedroom[/h2]
The hub has a completely new design to better accommodate the basic run and jump mechanics. 
You get the Hym-Bam attack as a reward when you reach the windowsill. While the bedroom is sandbox-styled, this gives you a chance to play around with the Hym-Bam attack. You can push toys around the room and break open a surprise box where you’re introduced to Codee!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/51f616ef4157bf950d850ebe4b427ecb561d085e.png[/img]

[h2]Changes to Hungry Hungry Hymble[/h2]
[list]
[*] New name - it is now called Rocky Farmlands
[*] New short missions - bring the merchant a burger to open his shop, and help a farmer clear pests away from his crops
[*] New NPC’s - magic yielding farmers who react if you intrude their patch
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/fe9a307dd331961680e383495d938d9dfcf2252b.png[/img]

[h2]Changes to Hymble, The Witch and the Wardrobe[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/6991c2c7a14d29a5332f250bc2811cda162a0abc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New level design - many players found it difficult to navigate and felt they were fighting with the camera. After playtesting, we can confirm that those issues are gone!
[*] New name - it is now called Toadstool Park
[*] New puzzle - for raising/lowering platforms. Use the Hym-Bubble in the podiums to control the platforms.
[*] New short missions - help the mother tortoises reunite with their lost babies
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/f964f125a0ce3cf35624b4a8a909931b865f3a73.png[/img] 

Well aren’t you excited? I hope so because it’s been eight months of remaking the demo, and fourteen months since we last updated the demo file on Steam.

Until next time!
JJ

notes.title: BIG UPDATE: Regarding the current gameplay
notes.notes:
Dear followers

We apologise if things are running slowly with Hymble Ventures hence why we haven’t updated much recently. As we were in the process of our business growth, we put the games development on hold to focus on establishing our business documents, and pitching the game to publishers and investors. There’s been no luck with securing extra funding thus far, however, the organisations we pitched to gave us excellent feedback which is greater than nothing. Some pointed out that the game’s message about autism (expressed heavily by the four health bar system) overshadowed the gameplay, making Hymble Ventures less fun and more educational. I know some of you see it as a positive educational tool about autism which is good, however, we never intended for this game to be educational at all. Besides, a game about avoiding sensory stimuli and monitoring the characters wellbeing is tedious, but will work as an educational resource. I (JJ, the creator) wanted Hymble Ventures to be a 3D platformer with a tribute to the 90’s gameplay, well fleshed out characters, and a charming narrative. 

The stresses and burnouts we’ve been facing meant we had to step back from the Hymble Ventures project for a while until we had a clearer vision for it. During my break, I enjoyed playing such platformers as A Hat in Time, Thomas Was Alone, and Cavern of Dreams. If it wasn’t for those games, I wouldn’t have got these exciting new ideas for Hymble Ventures!  

So moving forward, we will iterate the demo by weaving the neurodiverse themes into the gameplay a lot more so they appear subtle. This change will involve reducing the four sensory health bars to ONE traditional health bar, so Hymble’s health won’t be too headache-inducing to manage. Example below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/06894af89b0dd17ffdf2e6394e7dd8dbc670a487.jpg[/img]

The narrative will also get a proper treatment so Hymble has a clear goal. So far, Hymble wants to collect all the magical pieces that will lead her to discovering why she’s different to every other creature. Each piece grants her a new ability to help her progress further. Sound interesting to you? I hope so!

We would like to thank everyone in our community who supported us, and the project with shout outs across Twitter and fan arts! Hymble is still going because of you, we just want to make the game brilliant and worth your time.

Until next time. - JJ

notes.title: Demo Update for WASD Live
notes.notes:
To better accommodate a new player experience, the game starts in Hymble's bedroom where Codee gives players a short tutorial on the innovative four sense bar system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/f7bbea00b610d5c9792ecd542f67792f1bc9ccbe.png[/img]

Players at WASD will choose a level without having to complete 'Hungry Hungry Hymble's' first. Beginners of the platform genre or of the game itself are best suited for 'Hungry Hungry Hymble's', whereas 3D platforming pros may enjoy the challenges 'Hymble, The Witch and the Wardrobe' has to offer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/91b8932f69446707241fc6c92e4111b0c332b787.png[/img]


We are hoping to gain more wishlists from WASD as well as helpful feedback this week!

notes.title: Update coming soon
notes.notes:
Hey guys! 
For those wondering when the Steam demo will be updated, we are uncertain of when that will happen. But don’t worry, we’re not abandoning the project, we want the latest patch to be brilliant! We’ve also been busy refining our pitch deck in pursuit of a good chance with publishers, and applying for investment opportunities. So we’re giving a heads up of what’s to come when the demo is ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/9be352c8599fbfda3b46cc3c2c4179dfa6f699ee.png[/img]

Hymble Ventures now has a unique mix action-adventure platform and RPG genres, but we’re still marketing it as a 3D platformer. So as players collect fruit, they can trade them with a hungry merchant for healing items, each for a particular sense health bar. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/f57366e2301b28e990b1971ac94ed5eedcf09411.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/792e8c4cd1251f3d9811321fd0481544fb603e71.png[/img]

notes.title: Hymble Ventures Demo Update - November 2023
notes.notes:
We'd like to thank everyone for their great, detailed feedback!
Since Steam Next Fest October 2023, we've read through all the responses in our feedback form and selected key aspects for improvement. 

This later version should have
[list]
[*] A Settings menu for camera sensitivity and BGM volume
[*] Fixed camera movement
[*] A multiple controller input (XBox, Playstation)
[*] No festive skin (the holiday is over)
[*] More polished character/creature animations
[*] Less glitches and clipping
[*] Updated character dialogue
[*] Second attack toggle in Hymble, The Witch and the Wardrobe (you can use both Zorb Ball and Boomerang)
[*] No rectangular box in dialogue systems. All characters speak with speech bubbles.
[*] Zorb ball works by holding down RMB
[*] Iterated level design in Hymble, The Witch and the Wardrobe. There are more hills and trees 
[*] Hymble and Codee have blink animations
[*] Hymble no longer wades in water in Hungry Hungry Hymbles. She bounces off it during damage.
[/list]

There are still some aspects to polish up but we hope you enjoy the update and you feel the demo has improved!

notes.title: Hymble Ventures Alpha Demo Update
notes.notes:
The Canine Games team have been busy over the past 4 months on the Tranzfuser programme and have focused on a new Hymble Ventures prototype which is now added to this demo. So there are two distinct levels and a new health bar system that portrays the game's unique selling point. Gameplay focused on the five senses.

[list]
[*] Cute visual novel narrative elements
[*] Five health bars for five sense perceptions (touch, taste, sight, smell, sound) 
[*] Enemies attack according to what sense perception it damages e.g. firefly's that cast bright lights to damage sight sense
[*] Hymble and Codee are remodelled to look simple and appealing
[*] New artwork (sprites, UI, journal pages)
[/list]

Some features like the voice acting and cutscene before the level starting, have been removed for the time being. But don't worry, we'll put them back in when we update the demo further. 

[h1] Spooky Skins [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081880/22275c2c72bba5229eb9fe214930d139eab5764e.png[/img]

It's spooky season and we're excited to debut Hymble and Codee's holiday skins. You can see this feature if you play 'Hymble, The Witch and the Wardrobe'. If this goes down well, we can make more skins in future releases!
